options: 「這是屬於妳們的人生，不管最後決定留下來獲釋離開，我都支持妳們。」
「我們不是還有未完成的事嗎？等一切結束後，我們再一起回來吧？」
「妳們已經經歷太多了。如果這裡就是妳們想稱為家的地方，那就留下來吧。我們會帶著妳們的意志繼續往前的。」
「還是先請小雪和主教把這邊安頓下來，等我們把問題解決後，再回來討論未來看怎麼做？」
“These are your lives. Whether you decide to stay or leave, I will support you.”
“Don’t we still have unfinished business? Once everything is over, let’s come back together.”
“You’ve already been through so much. If this is the place you want to call home, then stay. We’ll carry your resolve with us as we move forward.”
“Why don’t we ask Yuki and the bishop to settle things here first? Once we’ve solved our problems, we can return and talk about what comes next.”
